name: Disney Inspire Visa Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR 18.49% to 27.99% variable; cash advance APR 28.74% variable; penalty APR up to 29.99%. 0% promotional APR for 6 months on select Disney vacation packages, then the variable purchase APR.

fx_fee.notes: Pricing & Terms list foreign transaction fees as None.

base_rate.description: 1% in Disney Rewards Dollars on all other card purchases.

categories.label: Purchases made directly at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com or Stream.ESPN.com
Gas stations and most other U.S. Disney locations

rewards.redemption_notes: Rewards Dollars can be redeemed through Pay Yourself Back for statement credits toward purchases at most U.S. Disney locations and Disney sites, or toward airline tickets purchased with the card.

signup_bonus.description: $300 Disney Gift Card eGift upon approval, plus a $200 statement credit after spending $1,000 on purchases in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Disney streaming credit
benefits.description: $10 statement credit each month after spending $10 or more on qualifying subscriptions at DisneyPlus.com, Hulu.com or Stream.ESPN.com. Yearly activation required.

benefits.title: Disney resort and cruise spend bonus
benefits.description: $200 Disney Rewards Dollars after spending $2,000 per anniversary year on U.S. Disney Resort stays and Disney Cruise Line bookings.

benefits.title: Theme park ticket credit
benefits.description: $100 statement credit after spending $200 per anniversary year on U.S. Disney theme park tickets.

notes: Issued by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. network_tier is recorded as none because neither the product page nor the Pricing & Terms page names the network package.
